results.name: Abdominal Crunches Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and resistance to your desired settings on the abdominal crunch machine. Sit on the seat and position your feet securely on the footrests.
Grab the handles, ensuring your elbows are pointed forward.
Engage your core muscles and crunch your abdominals by pulling your upper body forward and curling your chest towards your knees.
Hold the crunch for a second, then slowly return to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you crunch forward and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Avoid using momentum; focus on engaging your abdominal muscles throughout the exercise.
Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the backrest of the machine.
results.description: Abdominal Crunches Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Abdominal Crunches With Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent and feet placed on the floor.
Inhale and try reaching forward with straight arms while lifting your upper back off the floor. 3. Hold the end position for few seconds and slowly return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling on it with your hands to prevent strain.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement to maximize effectiveness.
Hold the crunch position for a count of two to five seconds to increase muscle activation and endurance.
results.description: Abdominal Crunches With Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Abdominal Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent, feet placed on the floor and arms raised to the shoulder height.
Squeeze your abdominals and lift your upper back off the floor, reaching forward with your arms
Hold for few seconds and slowly return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling on it with your hands to prevent strain.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement to maximize effectiveness.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift into the crunch and inhaling as you lower back down.
results.description: Abdominal Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques.

results.name: Abs Snails
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended, hands placed behind your hips.
Lean your torso backward while squeezing your glutes, extending your hips upward.
Contract your abdominal muscles to pull your torso back upright, returning your hips to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, while moving your body forward in the opposite direction.
tips: Move slowly and avoid using momentum to rock your body.
Maintain a straight back and avoid excessive arching or overextending.
Push your hands into the ground for stability
Exhale as you lift your hips, and pull your hips through your arms. Inhale at the starting position.
results.description: Abs Snails is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Abdominals, Shoulders.

results.name: Air Bike Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lift your shoulders off the floor, engaging your core.
Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while extending your right leg lightly.
Switch sides, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while extending your left leg lightly. Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding the use of momentum to maximize effectiveness.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you twist and bring your elbow to your knee, and inhaling as you switch sides.
results.description: Air Bike Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Air Twisting Crunch
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and heels on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Raise your chest and twist your torso to one side while bringing the opposite knee close.
Return to the initial position and repeat by twisting towards the other side.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control, avoiding the use of momentum to maximize effectiveness.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you twist and bring your elbow to your knee, and inhaling as you switch sides.
results.description: Air Twisting Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Hold
instructions: Start in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Hold this position for a brief period of 1-2 seconds.
Lower your right arm and left leg back to the plank position.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and holding for a brief period of 1-2 seconds before returning to the plank position.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you hold the position.
results.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Hold is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Rest Pause
instructions: Start in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Then lower back to the plank position and pause for a few seconds.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and return to the plank position and pause for a few seconds.
Continue alternating sides, lifting opposite arms and legs with a brief pause in the plank position.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you pause in the plank position.
results.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank Rest Pause is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Arm Leg Plank
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously, extending them straight out while maintaining balance. Hold briefly, then lower back to the plank position.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously, extending them straight out and holding briefly before returning to the plank position.
Continue alternating sides, lifting opposite arms and legs.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and prevent your hips from sagging.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and maintain balance.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your arm and leg and inhaling as you lower them back to the plank position.
results.description: Alternate Arm Leg Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Heel Touches
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor, engaging your core.
Reach your right hand towards your right heel, then return to the center position.
Reach your left hand towards your left heel. Continue alternating sides in this manner.
tips: Keep your shoulders off the mat and your core engaged throughout the exercise to maximize effectiveness.
Focus on using your oblique muscles to reach towards your heels rather than using your arms.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maintain proper form and maximize muscle engagement.
results.description: Alternate Heel Touches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.
